FAQ

Common questions

Yes! The free plan includes 50 requests per day, 3 collections, and access to basic tools. No credit card required to get started.

Absolutely. All your collections and requests are stored locally on your device. Cloud sync is optional and available on Pro and Team plans.

Yes, Fetchlab supports importing Postman Collection v2.1 format, cURL commands, OpenAPI/Swagger specs, and HAR files.

Cloud sync uses end-to-end encryption (AES-256-GCM) so your API data is encrypted before it leaves your device. Only you can decrypt your data.

All payments are processed through the App Store. You can use any payment method linked to your Apple ID, including credit cards, Apple Pay, and gift cards.

Yes, you can cancel anytime through your App Store subscription settings. You'll retain access until the end of your current billing period.
